blocks.en_text: So in college,
blocks.zh_text: 所以上大学的时候，

blocks.en_text: I was a government major,
blocks.zh_text: 我的专业是政治学，

blocks.en_text: which means I had to write a lot of papers.
blocks.zh_text: 这意味着我得写很多论文。

blocks.en_text: Now, when a normal student writes a paper,
blocks.zh_text: 普通学生写论文的时候，

blocks.en_text: they might spread the work out a little like this.
blocks.zh_text: 可能会把工作稍微分摊一下，就像这样。

blocks.en_text: So, you know --
blocks.zh_text: 所以，你知道——

blocks.en_text: you get started maybe a little slowly,
blocks.zh_text: 你开始的时候可能有点慢，

blocks.en_text: but you get enough done in the first week
blocks.zh_text: 但第一周你能完成足够多的量，

blocks.en_text: that, with some heavier days later on,
blocks.zh_text: 这样，后面几天再加重一些，

blocks.en_text: everything gets done, things stay civil.
blocks.zh_text: 一切都能完成，事情还算体面。

blocks.en_text: And I would want to do that like that.
blocks.zh_text: 我本来想那样做的。

blocks.en_text: That would be the plan.
blocks.zh_text: 那本该是计划。

blocks.en_text: I would have it all ready to go,
blocks.zh_text: 我会把一切都准备好，

blocks.en_text: but then, actually, the paper would come along,
blocks.zh_text: 但后来，实际上，论文来了，

blocks.en_text: and then I would kind of do this.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我就会变成这样。

blocks.en_text: And that would happen every single paper.
blocks.zh_text: 而且每篇论文都会这样。

blocks.en_text: But then came my 90-page senior thesis,
blocks.zh_text: 但后来来了我那篇90页的毕业论文，

blocks.en_text: a paper you're supposed to spend a year on.
blocks.zh_text: 一篇你本该花一年时间来写的论文。

blocks.en_text: And I knew for a paper like that, my normal work flow was not an option.
blocks.zh_text: 我知道对于这样一篇论文，我平常的工作流程根本行不通。

blocks.en_text: It was way too big a project.
blocks.zh_text: 这个项目太大了。

blocks.en_text: So I planned things out,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我做了规划，

blocks.en_text: and I decided I kind of had to go something like this.
blocks.zh_text: 我决定大概得这样做。

blocks.en_text: This is how the year would go.
blocks.zh_text: 这一年会这样过。

blocks.en_text: So I'd start off light,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我会轻松开始，

blocks.en_text: and I'd bump it up in the middle months,
blocks.zh_text: 中间几个月加大力度，

blocks.en_text: and then at the end, I would kick it up into high gear
blocks.zh_text: 然后到最后，我会全力冲刺，

blocks.en_text: just like a little staircase.
blocks.zh_text: 就像一个小楼梯。

blocks.en_text: How hard could it be to walk up the stairs?
blocks.zh_text: 走上楼梯能有多难呢？

blocks.en_text: No big deal, right?
blocks.zh_text: 没什么大不了的，对吧？

blocks.en_text: But then, the funniest thing happened.
blocks.zh_text: 但后来，最搞笑的事情发生了。

blocks.en_text: Those first few months?
blocks.zh_text: 最初那几个月呢？

blocks.en_text: They came and went,
blocks.zh_text: 来了又走了，

blocks.en_text: and I couldn't quite do stuff.
blocks.zh_text: 而我根本没法做事。

blocks.en_text: So we had an awesome new revised plan.
blocks.zh_text: 于是我们有了一个超棒的新修订计划。

blocks.en_text: And then --
blocks.zh_text: 然后——

blocks.en_text: But then those middle months actually went by,
blocks.zh_text: 但后来中间那几个月真的过去了，

blocks.en_text: and I didn't really write words,
blocks.zh_text: 而我并没有真正写出字来，

blocks.en_text: and so we were here.
blocks.zh_text: 于是我们就到了这里。

blocks.en_text: And then two months turned into one month,
blocks.zh_text: 然后两个月变成一个月，

blocks.en_text: which turned into two weeks.
blocks.zh_text: 又变成两周。

blocks.en_text: And one day I woke up
blocks.zh_text: 有一天我醒来，

blocks.en_text: with three days until the deadline,
blocks.zh_text: 距离截止日期只剩三天，

blocks.en_text: still not having written a word,
blocks.zh_text: 却还是一个字都没写，

blocks.en_text: and so I did the only thing I could:
blocks.zh_text: 于是我做了唯一能做的事：

blocks.en_text: I wrote 90 pages over 72 hours,
blocks.zh_text: 我在72小时里写了90页，

blocks.en_text: pulling not one but two all-nighters --
blocks.zh_text: 不是熬了一个通宵，而是熬了两个通宵——

blocks.en_text: humans are not supposed to pull two all-nighters --
blocks.zh_text: 人类本不该熬两个通宵的——

blocks.en_text: sprinted across campus,
blocks.zh_text: 我飞奔穿过校园，

blocks.en_text: dove in slow motion,
blocks.zh_text: 以慢动作扑过去，

blocks.en_text: and got it in just at the deadline.
blocks.zh_text: 刚好在截止日期前交上了。

blocks.en_text: I thought that was the end of everything.
blocks.zh_text: 我以为一切都完了。

blocks.en_text: But a week later I get a call,
blocks.zh_text: 但一周后我接到一个电话，

blocks.en_text: and it's the school.
blocks.zh_text: 是学校打来的。

blocks.en_text: And they say, "Is this Tim Urban?"
blocks.zh_text: 他们说：“是Tim Urban吗？”

blocks.en_text: And I say, "Yeah."
blocks.zh_text: 我说：“是的。”

blocks.en_text: And they say, "We need to talk about your thesis."
blocks.zh_text: 他们说：“我们得谈谈你的论文。”

blocks.en_text: And I say, "OK."
blocks.zh_text: 我说：“好啊。”

blocks.en_text: And they say,
blocks.zh_text: 他们说：

blocks.en_text: "It's the best one we've ever seen."
blocks.zh_text: “这是我们见过的最好的论文。”

blocks.en_text: That did not happen.
blocks.zh_text: 那并没有发生。

blocks.en_text: It was a very, very bad thesis.
blocks.zh_text: 那是一篇非常非常糟糕的论文。

blocks.en_text: I just wanted to enjoy that one moment when all of you thought,
blocks.zh_text: 我只是想享受一下那一刻，让你们所有人都以为，

blocks.en_text: "This guy is amazing!"
blocks.zh_text: “这家伙太厉害了！”

blocks.en_text: No, no, it was very, very bad.
blocks.zh_text: 不，不，它非常非常糟糕。

blocks.en_text: Anyway, today I'm a writer-blogger guy.
blocks.zh_text: 总之，现在我是个写博客的家伙。

blocks.en_text: I write the blog Wait But Why.
blocks.zh_text: 我写一个叫 Wait But Why 的博客。

blocks.en_text: And a couple of years ago, I decided to write about procrastination.
blocks.zh_text: 几年前，我决定写一写拖延症。

blocks.en_text: My behavior has always perplexed the non-procrastinators around me,
blocks.zh_text: 我的行为一直让我身边那些不拖延的人感到困惑，

blocks.en_text: and I wanted to explain to the non-procrastinators of the world
blocks.zh_text: 我想向世界上那些不拖延的人解释

blocks.en_text: what goes on in the heads of procrastinators,
blocks.zh_text: 拖延症患者脑子里到底在想什么，

blocks.en_text: and why we are the way we are.
blocks.zh_text: 以及我们为什么会是这样。

blocks.en_text: Now, I had a hypothesis
blocks.zh_text: 当时我有一个假设，

blocks.en_text: that the brains of procrastinators were actually different
blocks.zh_text: 那就是拖延症患者的大脑其实和别人的不一样，

blocks.en_text: than the brains of other people.
blocks.zh_text: 和别人的大脑不一样。

blocks.en_text: And to test this, I found an MRI lab
blocks.zh_text: 为了验证这一点，我找了一家核磁共振实验室，

blocks.en_text: that actually let me scan both my brain
blocks.zh_text: 他们真的让我扫描了我自己的大脑

blocks.en_text: and the brain of a proven non-procrastinator,
blocks.zh_text: 以及一个公认不拖延的人的大脑，

blocks.en_text: so I could compare them.
blocks.zh_text: 这样我就能把它们做个对比。

blocks.en_text: I actually brought them here to show you today.
blocks.zh_text: 我今天真的把它们带来给你们看了。

blocks.en_text: I want you to take a look carefully to see if you can notice a difference.
blocks.zh_text: 我想让你们仔细看一看，看能不能发现什么不同。

blocks.en_text: I know that if you're not a trained brain expert,
blocks.zh_text: 我知道，如果你不是受过训练的大脑专家，

blocks.en_text: it's not that obvious, but just take a look, OK?
blocks.zh_text: 差别没那么明显，但就看一眼，好吗？

blocks.en_text: So here's the brain of a non-procrastinator.
blocks.zh_text: 这是一个不拖延的人的大脑。

blocks.en_text: Now ...
blocks.zh_text: 现在……

blocks.en_text: here's my brain.
blocks.zh_text: 这是我的大脑。

blocks.en_text: There is a difference.
blocks.zh_text: 确实有区别。

blocks.en_text: Both brains have a Rational Decision-Maker in them,
blocks.zh_text: 两个大脑里都有一个理性的决策者，

blocks.en_text: but the procrastinator's brain
blocks.zh_text: 但拖延症患者的大脑里

blocks.en_text: also has an Instant Gratification Monkey.
blocks.zh_text: 还有一个即时满足猴子。

blocks.en_text: Now, what does this mean for the procrastinator?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，这对拖延症患者意味着什么呢？

blocks.en_text: Well, it means everything's fine until this happens.
blocks.zh_text: 意思是，一切都好，直到这件事发生。

blocks.en_text: [This is a perfect time to get some work done.] [Nope!]
blocks.zh_text: [现在正是做点工作的完美时机。] [才不呢！]

blocks.en_text: So the Rational Decision-Maker will make the rational decision
blocks.zh_text: 于是理性的决策者会做出理性的决定，

blocks.en_text: to do something productive,
blocks.zh_text: 去做一些有成效的事，

blocks.en_text: but the Monkey doesn't like that plan,
blocks.zh_text: 但猴子不喜欢这个计划，

blocks.en_text: so he actually takes the wheel,
blocks.zh_text: 所以他实际上抢过了方向盘，

blocks.en_text: and he says, "Actually, let's read the entire Wikipedia page
blocks.zh_text: 他说：“其实，咱们去把 Nancy Kerrigan 和 Tonya Harding 丑闻的

blocks.en_text: of the Nancy Kerrigan/ Tonya Harding scandal,
blocks.zh_text: 整个维基百科页面读一遍吧，

blocks.en_text: because I just remembered that that happened.
blocks.zh_text: 因为我刚想起来还有这么回事。

blocks.en_text: Then --
blocks.zh_text: 然后——

blocks.en_text: Then we're going to go over to the fridge,
blocks.zh_text: 然后我们要去冰箱那边，

blocks.en_text: to see if there's anything new in there since 10 minutes ago.
blocks.zh_text: 看看从十分钟前到现在有没有什么新东西。

blocks.en_text: After that, we're going to go on a YouTube spiral
blocks.zh_text: 之后，我们要在 YouTube 上越看越深，

blocks.en_text: that starts with videos of Richard Feynman talking about magnets
blocks.zh_text: 从 Richard Feynman 讲磁铁的的视频开始，

blocks.en_text: and ends much, much later with us watching interviews
blocks.zh_text: 然后过了很久很久，最后变成在看

blocks.en_text: with Justin Bieber's mom.
blocks.zh_text: Justin Bieber 妈妈的采访。

blocks.en_text: "All of that's going to take a while,
blocks.zh_text: “所有这些都得花上一阵子，

blocks.en_text: so we're not going to really have room on the schedule for any work today.
blocks.zh_text: 所以今天的日程上根本腾不出地方来做任何工作了。

blocks.en_text: Sorry!"
blocks.zh_text: 抱歉啦！”

blocks.en_text: (Sigh)
blocks.zh_text: （叹气）

blocks.en_text: Now, what is going on here?
blocks.zh_text: 那么，这到底是怎么回事呢？

blocks.en_text: The Instant Gratification Monkey does not seem like a guy
blocks.zh_text: 即时满足猴子看起来可不像是那种

blocks.en_text: you want behind the wheel.
blocks.zh_text: 你会想让他来掌方向盘的人。

blocks.en_text: He lives entirely in the present moment.
blocks.zh_text: 他完全活在当下这一刻。

blocks.en_text: He has no memory of the past, no knowledge of the future,
blocks.zh_text: 他对过去没有记忆，对未来一无所知，

blocks.en_text: and he only cares about two things:
blocks.zh_text: 他只在乎两件事：

blocks.en_text: easy and fun.
blocks.zh_text: 轻松和好玩。

blocks.en_text: Now, in the animal world, that works fine.
blocks.zh_text: 在动物世界里，这样完全没问题。

blocks.en_text: If you're a dog
blocks.zh_text: 如果你是一只狗，

blocks.en_text: and you spend your whole life doing nothing other than easy and fun things,
blocks.zh_text: 一辈子除了轻松好玩的事什么都不干，

blocks.en_text: you're a huge success!
blocks.zh_text: 那你就是巨大的成功！

blocks.en_text: And to the Monkey,
blocks.zh_text: 而在猴子眼里，

blocks.en_text: humans are just another animal species.
blocks.zh_text: 人类不过是又一个动物物种。

blocks.en_text: You have to keep well-slept, well-fed and propagating into the next generation,
blocks.zh_text: 你得睡好、吃饱、繁衍下一代，

blocks.en_text: which in tribal times might have worked OK.
blocks.zh_text: 这在部落时代也许还行得通。

blocks.en_text: But, if you haven't noticed, now we're not in tribal times.
blocks.zh_text: 但是，如果你没注意到的话，我们现在可不在部落时代了。

blocks.en_text: We're in an advanced civilization, and the Monkey does not know what that is.
blocks.zh_text: 我们身处一个先进的文明社会，而猴子根本不知道那是什么。

blocks.en_text: Which is why we have another guy in our brain,
blocks.zh_text: 这就是为什么我们脑子里还有另一个家伙，

blocks.en_text: the Rational Decision-Maker,
blocks.zh_text: 理性决策者，

blocks.en_text: who gives us the ability to do things no other animal can do.
blocks.zh_text: 他赋予我们做其他动物都做不到的事情的能力。

blocks.en_text: We can visualize the future.
blocks.zh_text: 我们能想象未来。

blocks.en_text: We can see the big picture.
blocks.zh_text: 我们能看清全局。

blocks.en_text: We can make long-term plans.
blocks.zh_text: 我们能制定长期计划。

blocks.en_text: And he wants to take all of that into account.
blocks.zh_text: 他想把这一切都考虑进去。

blocks.en_text: And he wants to just have us do
blocks.zh_text: 他就是想让我们去做

blocks.en_text: whatever makes sense to be doing right now.
blocks.zh_text: 此刻真正该做的事。

blocks.en_text: Now, sometimes it makes sense
blocks.zh_text: 有时候，做那些

blocks.en_text: to be doing things that are easy and fun,
blocks.zh_text: 轻松好玩的事确实是合理的，

blocks.en_text: like when you're having dinner or going to bed
blocks.zh_text: 比如吃晚饭、上床睡觉，

blocks.en_text: or enjoying well-earned leisure time.
blocks.zh_text: 或者享受应得的休闲时光。

blocks.en_text: That's why there's an overlap.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是为什么两者会有重叠。

blocks.en_text: Sometimes they agree.
blocks.zh_text: 有时候他们意见一致。

blocks.en_text: But other times, it makes much more sense
blocks.zh_text: 但其他时候，做那些更难、

blocks.en_text: to be doing things that are harder and less pleasant,
blocks.zh_text: 更不愉快的事情要合理得多，

blocks.en_text: for the sake of the big picture.
blocks.zh_text: 为了顾全大局。

blocks.en_text: And that's when we have a conflict.
blocks.zh_text: 这时候我们就产生了冲突。

blocks.en_text: And for the procrastinator,
blocks.zh_text: 而对于拖延症患者来说，

blocks.en_text: that conflict tends to end a certain way every time,
blocks.zh_text: 这种冲突每次往往都以同样的方式收场，

blocks.en_text: leaving him spending a lot of time in this orange zone,
blocks.zh_text: 让他花大量时间待在这个橙色区域里，

blocks.en_text: an easy and fun place that's entirely out of the Makes Sense circle.
blocks.zh_text: 一个轻松好玩、却完全在“合理”圆圈之外的地方。

blocks.en_text: I call it the Dark Playground.
blocks.zh_text: 我称之为黑暗游乐场。

blocks.en_text: Now, the Dark Playground is a place
blocks.zh_text: 这个黑暗游乐场，是一个

blocks.en_text: that all of you procrastinators out there know very well.
blocks.zh_text: 你们所有拖延症患者都非常熟悉的地方。

blocks.en_text: It's where leisure activities happen
blocks.zh_text: 休闲活动就是在这里发生的，

blocks.en_text: at times when leisure activities are not supposed to be happening.
blocks.zh_text: 而且是在本不该发生休闲活动的时候。

blocks.en_text: The fun you have in the Dark Playground
blocks.zh_text: 你在黑暗游乐场里得到的乐趣

blocks.en_text: isn't actually fun, because it's completely unearned,
blocks.zh_text: 其实并不算乐趣，因为那完全是不劳而获的，

blocks.en_text: and the air is filled with guilt, dread, anxiety, self-hatred --
blocks.zh_text: 空气里弥漫着内疚、恐惧、焦虑、自我厌恶——

blocks.en_text: all of those good procrastinator feelings.
blocks.zh_text: 全都是拖延症患者熟悉的美好感受。

blocks.en_text: And the question is, in this situation, with the Monkey behind the wheel,
blocks.zh_text: 问题是，在这种情况下，猴子握着方向盘，

blocks.en_text: how does the procrastinator ever get himself over here to this blue zone,
blocks.zh_text: 拖延症患者到底怎么才能让自己来到这边这个蓝色区域，

blocks.en_text: a less pleasant place, but where really important things happen?
blocks.zh_text: 一个不那么舒服、但真正重要的事情会发生的地方？

blocks.en_text: Well, turns out the procrastinator has a guardian angel,
blocks.zh_text: 结果发现，拖延症患者有一位守护天使，

blocks.en_text: someone who's always looking down on him and watching over him
blocks.zh_text: 一个总是俯视着他、守护着他的人，

blocks.en_text: in his darkest moments --
blocks.zh_text: 在他最黑暗的时刻——

blocks.en_text: someone called the Panic Monster.
blocks.zh_text: 这个人叫恐慌怪兽。

blocks.en_text: Now, the Panic Monster is dormant most of the time,
blocks.zh_text: 恐慌怪兽大部分时间都在休眠，

blocks.en_text: but he suddenly wakes up anytime a deadline gets too close
blocks.zh_text: 但只要截止日期太近了，他就会突然醒来，

blocks.en_text: or there's danger of public embarrassment,
blocks.zh_text: 或者有当众出丑的危险，

blocks.en_text: a career disaster or some other scary consequence.
blocks.zh_text: 事业灾难或其他可怕的后果。

blocks.en_text: And importantly, he's the only thing the Monkey is terrified of.
blocks.zh_text: 重要的是，他是猴子唯一害怕的东西。

blocks.en_text: Now, he became very relevant in my life pretty recently,
blocks.zh_text: 他最近在我的生活里变得非常重要，

blocks.en_text: because the people of TED reached out to me about six months ago
blocks.zh_text: 因为大约六个月前，TED的人联系了我，

blocks.en_text: and invited me to do a TED Talk.
blocks.zh_text: 邀请我做一场TED演讲。

blocks.en_text: Now, of course, I said yes.
blocks.zh_text: 当然，我答应了。

blocks.en_text: It's always been a dream of mine to have done a TED Talk in the past.
blocks.zh_text: 在过去做过一场TED演讲，一直是我的梦想。

blocks.en_text: But in the middle of all this excitement,
blocks.zh_text: 但在这一片兴奋之中，

blocks.en_text: the Rational Decision-Maker seemed to have something else on his mind.
blocks.zh_text: 理性决策者似乎心里在想别的事。

blocks.en_text: He was saying, "Are we clear on what we just accepted?
blocks.zh_text: 他说：“我们清楚自己刚刚接受了什么吗？

blocks.en_text: Do we get what's going to be now happening one day in the future?
blocks.zh_text: 我们明白未来某一天将会发生什么吗？

blocks.en_text: We need to sit down and work on this right now."
blocks.zh_text: 我们现在就得坐下来开始做这件事。”

blocks.en_text: And the Monkey said, "Totally agree, but let's just open Google Earth
blocks.zh_text: 猴子说：“完全同意，不过我们先打开谷歌地球

blocks.en_text: and zoom in to the bottom of India, like 200 feet above the ground,
blocks.zh_text: 放大到印度底部，离地面大概200英尺的地方，

blocks.en_text: and scroll up for two and a half hours til we get to the top of the country,
blocks.zh_text: 然后往上滚动两个半小时，一直到这个国家的顶部，

blocks.en_text: so we can get a better feel for India."
blocks.zh_text: 这样我们就能更好地感受一下印度。”

blocks.en_text: So that's what we did that day.
blocks.zh_text: 那天我们就这么干了。

blocks.en_text: As six months turned into four and then two and then one,
blocks.zh_text: 随着六个月变成四个月，再变成两个月，再变成一个月，

blocks.en_text: the people of TED decided to release the speakers.
blocks.zh_text: TED的人决定公布演讲者名单。

blocks.en_text: And I opened up the website, and there was my face
blocks.zh_text: 我打开网站，我的脸就在那里，

blocks.en_text: staring right back at me.
blocks.zh_text: 直直地盯着我。

blocks.en_text: And guess who woke up?
blocks.zh_text: 猜猜谁醒了？

blocks.en_text: So the Panic Monster starts losing his mind,
blocks.zh_text: 于是恐慌怪兽开始发疯，

blocks.en_text: and a few seconds later, the whole system's in mayhem.
blocks.zh_text: 几秒钟后，整个系统一片混乱。

blocks.en_text: And the Monkey -- remember, he's terrified of the Panic Monster --
blocks.zh_text: 而猴子——记住，他害怕恐慌怪兽——

blocks.en_text: boom, he's up the tree!
blocks.zh_text: 砰，他就爬上树了！

blocks.en_text: And finally,
blocks.zh_text: 最后，

blocks.en_text: finally, the Rational Decision-Maker can take the wheel
blocks.zh_text: 终于，理性决策者能来掌舵了

blocks.en_text: and I can start working on the talk.
blocks.zh_text: 我也能开始准备演讲了。

blocks.en_text: Now, the Panic Monster explains
blocks.zh_text: 那么，恐慌怪兽解释了

blocks.en_text: all kinds of pretty insane procrastinator behavior,
blocks.zh_text: 各种相当疯狂的拖延行为，

blocks.en_text: like how someone like me could spend two weeks
blocks.zh_text: 比如像我这样的人怎么会花上两个星期

blocks.en_text: unable to start the opening sentence of a paper,
blocks.zh_text: 都没法动笔写论文的开头一句，

blocks.en_text: and then miraculously find the unbelievable work ethic
blocks.zh_text: 然后又能奇迹般地拿出难以置信的敬业精神

blocks.en_text: to stay up all night and write eight pages.
blocks.zh_text: 熬上一整夜，写出八页纸。

blocks.en_text: And this entire situation, with the three characters --
blocks.zh_text: 而这整个局面，加上这三个角色——

blocks.en_text: this is the procrastinator's system.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是拖延者的系统。

blocks.en_text: It's not pretty, but in the end, it works.
blocks.zh_text: 它不太好看，但最终，它管用。

blocks.en_text: This is what I decided to write about on the blog a couple of years ago.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是几年前我决定在博客上写的内容。

blocks.en_text: When I did, I was amazed by the response.
blocks.zh_text: 写完之后，大家的反应让我很惊讶。

blocks.en_text: Literally thousands of emails came in,
blocks.zh_text: 真的有好几千封邮件涌进来，

blocks.en_text: from all different kinds of people from all over the world,
blocks.zh_text: 来自世界各地各种各样的人，

blocks.en_text: doing all different kinds of things.
blocks.zh_text: 做着各种各样的事。

blocks.en_text: These are people who were nurses, bankers, painters, engineers
blocks.zh_text: 这些人里有护士、银行家、画家、工程师

blocks.en_text: and lots and lots of PhD students.
blocks.zh_text: 还有许许多多的博士生。

blocks.en_text: And they were all writing, saying the same thing:
blocks.zh_text: 他们都在写，说着同样的话：

blocks.en_text: "I have this problem too."
blocks.zh_text: “我也有这个问题。”

blocks.en_text: But what struck me was the contrast between the light tone of the post
blocks.zh_text: 但让我触动的是，那篇文章轻松的语调

blocks.en_text: and the heaviness of these emails.
blocks.zh_text: 和这些邮件沉重的内容之间的反差。

blocks.en_text: These people were writing with intense frustration
blocks.zh_text: 这些人写的时候带着强烈的挫败感，

blocks.en_text: about what procrastination had done to their lives,
blocks.zh_text: 写拖延给他们的生活带来了什么，

blocks.en_text: about what this Monkey had done to them.
blocks.zh_text: 写这只猴子对他们做了什么。

blocks.en_text: And I thought about this, and I said,
blocks.zh_text: 我琢磨了一下，然后说，

blocks.en_text: well, if the procrastinator's system works, then what's going on?
blocks.zh_text: 好吧，如果拖延者的系统管用，那到底是怎么回事？

blocks.en_text: Why are all of these people in such a dark place?
blocks.zh_text: 为什么这些人都陷在这么灰暗的境地？

blocks.en_text: Well, it turns out that there's two kinds of procrastination.
blocks.zh_text: 结果发现，拖延有两种。

blocks.en_text: Everything I've talked about today, the examples I've given,
blocks.zh_text: 我今天讲的所有内容、我举的例子，

blocks.en_text: they all have deadlines.
blocks.zh_text: 它们都有截止日期。

blocks.en_text: And when there's deadlines,
blocks.zh_text: 而当有截止日期时，

blocks.en_text: the effects of procrastination are contained to the short term
blocks.zh_text: 拖延的影响就被限制在短期内，

blocks.en_text: because the Panic Monster gets involved.
blocks.zh_text: 因为恐慌怪兽会介入。

blocks.en_text: But there's a second kind of procrastination
blocks.zh_text: 但还有第二种拖延，

blocks.en_text: that happens in situations when there is no deadline.
blocks.zh_text: 它发生在没有截止日期的情况下。

blocks.en_text: So if you wanted a career where you're a self-starter --
blocks.zh_text: 所以如果你想要一份靠自我驱动的职业——

blocks.en_text: something in the arts, something entrepreneurial --
blocks.zh_text: 艺术类的，或者创业类的——

blocks.en_text: there's no deadlines on those things at first, because nothing's happening,
blocks.zh_text: 这些事一开始都没有截止日期，因为什么都还没发生，

blocks.en_text: not until you've gone out and done the hard work
blocks.zh_text: 除非你走出去，付出艰苦的努力

blocks.en_text: to get momentum, get things going.
blocks.zh_text: 去获得动力，把事情推动起来。

blocks.en_text: There's also all kinds of important things outside of your career
blocks.zh_text: 除了事业之外，还有各种重要的事情

blocks.en_text: that don't involve any deadlines,
blocks.zh_text: 是不涉及任何截止日期的，

blocks.en_text: like seeing your family or exercising and taking care of your health,
blocks.zh_text: 比如看望家人，或者锻炼身体、照顾健康，

blocks.en_text: working on your relationship
blocks.zh_text: 经营你的感情关系

blocks.en_text: or getting out of a relationship that isn't working.
blocks.zh_text: 或者从一段不合适的感情中抽身出来。

blocks.en_text: Now if the procrastinator's only mechanism of doing these hard things
blocks.zh_text: 如果拖延者做这些难事的唯一机制

blocks.en_text: is the Panic Monster, that's a problem,
blocks.zh_text: 就是恐慌怪兽，那就有问题了，

blocks.en_text: because in all of these non-deadline situations,
blocks.zh_text: 因为在所有这些没有截止日期的情况下，

blocks.en_text: the Panic Monster doesn't show up.
blocks.zh_text: 恐慌怪兽根本不会出现。

blocks.en_text: He has nothing to wake up for,
blocks.zh_text: 它没有什么需要被唤醒的，

blocks.en_text: so the effects of procrastination, they're not contained;
blocks.zh_text: 所以拖延的影响并不会被控制住；

blocks.en_text: they just extend outward forever.
blocks.zh_text: 它们只会一直向外蔓延。

blocks.en_text: And it's this long-term kind of procrastination
blocks.zh_text: 而正是这种长期的拖延

blocks.en_text: that's much less visible and much less talked about
blocks.zh_text: 比起那种更好笑、短期的、有截止日期的拖延，

blocks.en_text: than the funnier, short-term deadline-based kind.
blocks.zh_text: 要隐蔽得多，也被谈论得少得多。

blocks.en_text: It's usually suffered quietly and privately.
blocks.zh_text: 它通常是人们默默独自承受的。

blocks.en_text: And it can be the source
blocks.zh_text: 而它可能成为

blocks.en_text: of a huge amount of long-term unhappiness, and regrets.
blocks.zh_text: 大量长期的不快乐和遗憾的根源。

blocks.en_text: And I thought, that's why those people are emailing,
blocks.zh_text: 我就想，这就是那些人发邮件的原因，

blocks.en_text: and that's why they're in such a bad place.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是他们处境那么糟的原因。

blocks.en_text: It's not that they're cramming for some project.
blocks.zh_text: 并不是他们在为某个项目临时抱佛脚。

blocks.en_text: It's that long-term procrastination has made them feel like a spectator,
blocks.zh_text: 而是长期拖延让他们有时觉得自己像个旁观者，

blocks.en_text: at times, in their own lives.
blocks.zh_text: 在自己的人生里像个旁观者。

blocks.en_text: The frustration is not that they couldn't achieve their dreams;
blocks.zh_text: 令人沮丧的不是他们没能实现梦想；

blocks.en_text: it's that they weren't even able to start chasing them.
blocks.zh_text: 而是他们甚至都没能开始去追逐梦想。

blocks.en_text: So I read these emails and I had a little bit of an epiphany --
blocks.zh_text: 所以我读了这些邮件，有了一点顿悟——

blocks.en_text: that I don't think non-procrastinators exist.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得不拖延的人根本不存在。

blocks.en_text: That's right -- I think all of you are procrastinators.
blocks.zh_text: 没错——我觉得你们所有人都是拖延者。

blocks.en_text: Now, you might not all be a mess,
blocks.zh_text: 当然，你们可能不是每个人都一团糟，

blocks.en_text: like some of us,
blocks.zh_text: 不像我们中的一些人，

blocks.en_text: and some of you may have a healthy relationship with deadlines,
blocks.zh_text: 你们中有些人可能和截止日期有着健康的关系，

blocks.en_text: but remember: the Monkey's sneakiest trick
blocks.zh_text: 但记住：猴子最狡猾的伎俩

blocks.en_text: is when the deadlines aren't there.
blocks.zh_text: 就是在没有截止日期的时候。

blocks.en_text: Now, I want to show you one last thing.
blocks.zh_text: 现在，我想给你们看最后一样东西。

blocks.en_text: I call this a Life Calendar.
blocks.zh_text: 我把它叫做人生日历。

blocks.en_text: That's one box for every week of a 90-year life.
blocks.zh_text: 这是九十年人生中每一周对应一个格子。

blocks.en_text: That's not that many boxes,
blocks.zh_text: 格子其实没那么多，

blocks.en_text: especially since we've already used a bunch of those.
blocks.zh_text: 尤其是我们已经用掉了一大堆。

blocks.en_text: So I think we need to all take a long, hard look at that calendar.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我觉得我们都需要好好、认真地看看那张日历。

blocks.en_text: We need to think about what we're really procrastinating on,
blocks.zh_text: 我们需要想想自己真正在拖延的是什么，

blocks.en_text: because everyone is procrastinating on something in life.
blocks.zh_text: 因为每个人在生活中都在拖延某件事。

blocks.en_text: We need to stay aware of the Instant Gratification Monkey.
blocks.zh_text: 我们需要时刻警惕那只即时满足猴子。

blocks.en_text: That's a job for all of us.
blocks.zh_text: 这是我们所有人的任务。

blocks.en_text: And because there's not that many boxes on there,
blocks.zh_text: 而且因为上面的格子没那么多，

blocks.en_text: it's a job that should probably start today.
blocks.zh_text: 这项任务可能应该从今天就开始。

blocks.en_text: Well, maybe not today, but ...
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，也许不是今天，但是……

blocks.en_text: You know.
blocks.zh_text: 你知道的。

blocks.en_text: Sometime soon.
blocks.zh_text: 很快的某一天。

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢。
